title: feat: add Cerberus Jev security review agent
author: murderszn
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15723

- Adds a small security triage code agent: Jev selects contain, investigate, or maintain; code chooses the playbook and a text model explains it.
- Uses `pollinations("/alpha/decisions", …)` and `openai/gpt-5.4-nano` with the caller’s Pollen. Failed or invalid decisions stop the run; JSON and streaming responses retain downstream provider usage.
- Source/deployment: https://github.com/murderszn/cerberus (root `agent.ts`). Callable model: `community/murderszn/cerberus`, currently private; publisher access requested in #16165.
- Real deployed runs on October 1: exposed database → contain (1.00); ambiguous static query warning → investigate (1.00); passing scan plus runtime checks → maintain (0.74), investigate (0.26). Input summaries and probabilities are recorded in the README.
- Validation: four direct-import tests pass; Biome passes. The related browser app’s live Jev queue also passed and is submitted separately in #16163 for #15722.

gist.headline: Three paths, one watchful pup
gist.blurb: murderszn built Cerberus Jev, a small security-triage agent that picks a playbook before asking a text model to explain it. The code is open; its callable community model is still private.
gist.summary: Cerberus Jev uses pollinations('/alpha/decisions', …) to select contain, investigate, or maintain, then openai/gpt-5.4-nano explains the chosen playbook using the caller’s Pollen.
gist.impact: Developers can inspect and test the open-source agent, including its fail-closed decisions and preserved provider usage data; community/murderszn/cerberus remains private while publisher access is requested.
gist.visual_concept: Cerberus is a security-triage agent, not a documented mascot: depict it as a friendly three-headed pixel puppy beside three garden paths labeled contain, investigate, and maintain. Polli, wearing a tiny watchkeeper badge, helps the pup tend code-plants; a cozy terminal represents the decision and explanation steps.
